"![](images/ac/ac756d7cbd687a23a5b2c1ffcb368298f4676178e8bebccbadd4e837fe66a3d7.png)

Consider the vector field $F(x,y,z),$ shown above. Given that $F(x,y,z)$ is independent of $z,$ which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.

- **I.** $\text{curl}\,F=0$
- **II.** $\text{curl}\,F\ne 0$
- **III.** $F$ is irrotational
- **IV.** $\text{curl}\,F$ points in the positive $z$-direction." :question/worked-solution "Recall that $\text{curl}\,F$ denotes the curl of the vector field $F.$

To understand intuitively whether a vector field has curl at a point $P$, imagine that $F$ represents the velocity field of flowing water. Place a paddlewheel at $P$ with its axis in the $z$-direction. If it rotates, the field has nonzero curl; if it does not, the field has zero curl.

The arrows turn a paddlewheel counterclockwise. Thus $\text{curl}\,F\ne 0$ throughout space, so $F$ is not irrotational. Curl measures local rotation, even when the arrows also spread outward. Wrap the fingers of your right hand in the counterclockwise direction: your thumb points out of the screen, in the positive $z$-direction.

With that in mind, check each statement:

- Statement I is false.
- Statement II is true.
- Statement III is false.
- Statement IV is true.

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and IV only."" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["902b4a07-6d8b-5503-adc1-c2e50d71cada" "6b93784d-4281-5760-8eef-4865819e8b08" "d88cb888-c4d7-5ba8-baab-76faa9062e42" "5de480c0-0dd0-5de8-af4e-b39414765809"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "eeb83bec-06ef-5f4e-a6b0-fb954fd138bf" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186133881.py"} [:db/add 17592186133881 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186133881 :knowledge-point/questions ["7f1277c2-1732-59aa-9938-5b092ddfb7eb"]} [:db/ensure 17592186133881 :knowledge-point/validate]]
